The player is currently blocked by the red square — the red square is an obstacle (the player cannot move into it). The top-right red square (3x3) was passable, but this 5x5 square blocked the player.
Hmm wait, actually — was the player blocked by the red square, or by the black? Let me check: the player is at rows 32-36, columns 14-18 (cell (4,0)). Moving DOWN → rows 38-42, columns 14-18. The red square is exactly at rows 38-42, columns 14-18. The surrounding cells: (5,0) = rows 37-42, columns 13-18: row 37 is black, rows 38-42 are red (columns 14-18) + black (columns 13, 18). Or: the red square is a "laser emitter," and the player can pass through the emitter but not through the beam? No, the player is blocked by the square itself.
